timeline.summary: Sisay recalls throwing fruit to drakes along the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: "We threw dried fruit to the drakes that rode the air, streaming along the *Weatherlight'*s side as we sailed amidst the clouds."

citation.text: Teferi's Drake (Mirage, 1996), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard returns to the Weatherlight as captain in Sisay's absence after serving in the Benalish army.
timeline.quote: Now, after serving nobly in the Benalish army, he has returned to the *Weatherlight* to serve as captain in Sisay's absence

citation.text: Gerrard (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Mirri rejoins Gerrard aboard the Weatherlight as his unofficial first mate.
timeline.quote: she rejoined Gerrard aboard the *Weatherlight* as his unofficial first mate

citation.text: Mirri (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax joins the Weatherlight crew to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: joining the crew of the *Weatherlight* as they seek to rescue their abducted captain Sisay.

citation.text: Crovax (Vanguard Series, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax accepts a place aboard the Weatherlight, leaving his rotting family.
timeline.quote: "You must be mad to want one such as I aboard the *Weatherlight*. But I would be mad to remain here with my rotting family. I accept."

citation.text: Shattered Crypt (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight banks as an aboroth rises to crush a lone rider.
timeline.quote: The *Weatherlight* banked sharply as the colossal beast rose up to crush the lone rider.

citation.text: Aboroth (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay says angering the gods turns clouds against you.
timeline.quote: "You know you've angered the gods when the clouds turn against you."

citation.text: Cloud Elemental (World Championship Decks 1997, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Crovax watches Selenia lead the Predator to the Weatherlight and feels betrayed.
timeline.quote: Crovax had witnessed Selenia lead the *Predator* to the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Enfeeblement (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Barbed slivers form a deadly hedge around the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: forming a deadly hedge around the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Barbed Sliver (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Predator lists the Weatherlight and Hanna screams.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* suddenly listed.

citation.text: Sudden Impact (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight hauls the Predator behind it.
timeline.quote: The *Weatherlight* dragged the *Predator* behind it

citation.text: Cataclysm (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Flowstone lunges at the Weatherlight, seeming to take on Greven's rage.
timeline.quote: it lunged like a wild beast at the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Seismic Assault (Exodus, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight bursts from the underground hangar as Mercadia falls.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* burst from the underground hangar.

citation.text: Mercadia's Downfall (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Sisay run deeper into the mountain unwilling to leave without the Weatherlight and crew.
timeline.quote: Neither of them intended to leave Mercadia without the *Weatherlight* and its crew.

citation.text: Tremor (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay is restored, the Legacy recovered, and the Weatherlight sails for Dominaria.
timeline.quote: the *Weatherlight* was sailing home to Dominaria.

citation.text: Tranquility (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Karn repairs the planeswalking engine and sees how to catalyze the Weatherlight's evolution.
timeline.quote: Karn saw for the first time how he could catalyze the *Weatherlight*'s evolution.

citation.text: Power Matrix (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Gerrard smiles as the Phyrexian portals disappear behind the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Gerrard savored a grim smile as the Phyrexian portals disappeared behind the *Weatherlight*.

citation.text: Distorting Wake (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sisay discovers the Weatherlight's mirrored hull can be used defensively.
timeline.quote: Sisay discovered that the mirrored hull of the *Weatherlight* could be used as a defensive weapon.

citation.text: Captain's Maneuver (Apocalypse, 2001), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Starke tells Sisay that he knows the Legacy is the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes and that its pieces were stolen from the child Gerrard.
timeline.quote: I know it to be the only means of defeating the Lord of the Wastes

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke reveals that the sidar's son is alive and called Volrath, and that he knows where Volrath is and how much of the Legacy he holds.
timeline.quote: I also know he is alive and now called Volrath.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke names his price for the information: his daughter.
timeline.quote: "My daughter," Starke answered.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard recalls that chasing the Legacy cost the lives of friends and is why he left the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: chasing after the Legacy cost the lives of friends.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Sisay tells Tahngarth she has agreed to help rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy.
timeline.quote: This servant, Volrath, is holding Starke's daughter prisoner.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay predicts that Gerrard will never be free of the Legacy.
timeline.quote: He'll never be free of the Legacy. He just doesn't know it yet.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight, with Gerrard aboard, sets sail from Benalia.
timeline.quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , with Gerrard aboard, set sail from Benalia.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke betrays Sisay by opening a portal at Volrath's command, from which massive hands drag her away.
timeline.quote: She was alone with the traitor, alone against Volrath's power, directed at her by Starke.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay is abducted through the circle, and Starke leaves Volrath's abduction note beside her ring and flees the ship.
timeline.quote: Starke shivered as he put Volrath's abduction note on the table with Sisay's ring.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight, without Sisay aboard, sets sail for Benalia.
timeline.quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , without Sisay aboard, set sail for Benalia.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Starke decides to seek allies after learning Gerrard is no longer aboard the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: It's time I sought allies.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight drops from above into the ogres, scattering them and killing most of them, leaving only Maraxus.
timeline.quote: And then the Weatherlight fell from above, dropping amidst the ogres, scattering them like leaves on the breeze.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard sends Tahngarth, Crovax and Starke to the ship to leave him alone against Maraxus, whose strength depends on those around him.
timeline.quote: that you draw your strength from whatever's around you, whoever's near. Look around. You're alone.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay asks to fly higher out of a storm.
timeline.quote: Fly us higher, out of its storm.

citation.text: Waterspout Djinn (Duel Decks: Jace vs. Chandra, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Spines of slivers leap between them, forming a hedge around the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: forming a deadly hedge around the

citation.text: Barbed Sliver (Premium Deck Series: Slivers, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Hadi spot the wreck of the Weatherlight on the sea floor.
timeline.quote: the long spine half-buried in the muck and waterweeds was too straight for any natural formation

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira hires the Vodalian Ziva to raise the Weatherlight within a day for double pay.
timeline.quote: The price is doubled if you can bring it up within two days,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 1" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira views the raised wreck of the Weatherlight on a Bogardan beach.
timeline.quote: Jhoira stood on the shore looking at what was left of the great skyship

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana is moved by the Weatherlight's skeleton, recognizing it as Gerrard's blade.
timeline.quote: It's Gerrard's blade in the portraits.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna agrees to serve on the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then I would consider it an honor to have you on my crew.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff shows his skill by creating an illusion of the original Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: In the distance the original version of the Weatherlight angled across the sky.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight is restored and ready to launch.
timeline.quote: The Weatherlight was whole and ready to launch.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 3" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana and Hadi repair the Weatherlight's engines on Bogardan.
timeline.quote: Tell Tien she wasn't wrong.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: A giant burning phoenix swoops on the Weatherlight camp.
timeline.quote: Streaking toward them from the mountains was a phoenix.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad shoots arrows into the phoenix, saving the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then the phoenix jerked, knocked off its course by an arrow slamming into its neck.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana resolves to serve on the Weatherlight when Jhoira returns.
timeline.quote: It wasn't the purpose she had been born for, but it was the one she wanted more than anything.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 4" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Ajani meets Jhoira aboard the finished Weatherlight and asks about the planeswalkers he told her of.
timeline.quote: Thank you for meeting me here,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight descends to the signal tower to pick up Gideon and Liliana.
timeline.quote: as the giant skyship dropped down toward them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira explains the Blackblade killed an elder dragon.
timeline.quote: It killed an elder dragon.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira describes the Blackblade as a soul-drinker made with death magic.
timeline.quote: But it's a soul-drinker, created with death magic, and steals the life-energy of everyone it kills.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon refuses to use a soul-drinker under any circumstances.
timeline.quote: A soul-drinker is not something we would want to use, under any circumstances.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Shanna notes the Blackblade is locked in the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: It's also locked up in the Stronghold,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira says she knows a time mage who can help.
timeline.quote: But I know just the time mage who can.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 5" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight appears overhead, which Teferi calls his past catching up.
timeline.quote: It's my past, catching up with me.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: The group escapes as sand floods the well and the Weatherlight drops ladders.
timeline.quote: The plateau is sinking.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira reveals she holds Teferi's planeswalker spark in a Powerstone and must convince him to take it back.
timeline.quote: It held Teferi's Planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Multani and the trees with time magic from the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: "It's time magic."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra recognizes Gideon and Liliana aboard the Weatherlight as they call the group to come aboard.
timeline.quote: "Gideon!" She waved wildly.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks onto the moving Weatherlight and warns that Bolas is preparing a trap for planeswalkers.
timeline.quote: Ajani wanted us to meet and regroup, but Bolas is preparing a trap for Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Gideon and Chandra to leave with him and says Liliana cannot be trusted, but Gideon refuses and Chandra chooses to stay.
timeline.quote: You don't understand. You can't trust her.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace leaves alone, warning Gideon not to be a fool as he was.
timeline.quote: "Don't be a fool, Gideon. Like I was."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon agrees to use the Blackblade if it can be found in Belzenlok's Stronghold.
timeline.quote: If we can find it in the Stronghold, I'll use it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi decides to take back his spark, and Jhoira drops the pendant into his palm.
timeline.quote: She pulled the pendant off her neck and dropped it into Teferi's waiting palm. "Welcome back."

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 9" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 9 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot, a spore on the Weatherlight's hull, escapes workers about to pry it off when fire erupts and climbs onto the deck, then falls into the engine compartment near the glowing white star.
timeline.quote: It plunged down through dark empty air and landed with a splat.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot grows in the dark, learning the voices of the crew, including Tiana and Arvad.
timeline.quote: This Cabal agent has been able to fool an entire academy of mages

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi tells Jhoira he does not regret giving up his spark.
timeline.quote: I regret a lot of things. But not that.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers to take Jaya to the Academy in Tolaria West, and Jaya says she is not sure how back she is yet.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure just how back I am yet, if you know what I mean.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana and Gideon argue over whether Gideon should have told Chandra about Josu to push her to help kill Belzenlok.
timeline.quote: Because she agrees with us that it has to be done before we face Nicol Bolas again.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad finds Slimefoot and its sprouts in the storage space beside the engine compartment, and Slimefoot waves back at him and Tiana.
timeline.quote: Slimefoot freed a second armstalk and waved at both of them.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff identifies Slimefoot as a thallid that probably came aboard as a spore on the tree elemental seed Jhoira used, and notes it already has about ten babies.
timeline.quote: This one probably came aboard as a spore, stuck to that tree elemental seed Jhoira used to regrow the hull.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Tiana decides to leave the thallids where they are while she goes to speak to Jhoira.
timeline.quote: Right, let's just leave it where it is right now. I'm going to talk to Jhoira.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Slimefoot and its sprouts leave their den and meet Liliana, who asks Arvad how he resisted drinking blood.
timeline.quote: How did you decide not to eat people?

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Arvad explains he held on to an image of himself before he was changed, and Liliana learns there is no trick; she threatens Tiana and Arvad not to tell anyone about the talk.
timeline.quote: And if you tell anyone we had this conversation, you'll both regret it.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Gideon and Teferi wave off the thallids as someone else's problem.
timeline.quote: That sounds like someone else's problem,

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira decides to take the thallids back to Yavimaya when possible, accepting them aboard.
timeline.quote: I must have brought them here with Molimo's seed, so we'll have to take them back to Yavimaya when we have a chance.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Karn apologizes for disturbing Yavimaya to retrieve the Sylex and says he means to end the Phyrexians forever.
timeline.quote: I mean to end them forever.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra practices concentration with thirty-seven fireballs while Jaya says what the Multani episode showed her.
timeline.quote: It was the first indication I'd ever seen that you were capable of concentrating on something for any length of time.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 10" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 May 2018.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crosses into Urborg at dusk, and Jhoira reports the defaced monument she calls the Fools' Tomb.
timeline.quote: Apparently the Cabal calls it the Fools' Tomb.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Raff casts an illusion that gives Chandra a sword scar for her Cabal bounty hunter disguise.
timeline.quote: Her skin puckered and pulled, creating a sword scar that ran from one side of her forehead to her jaw.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana says she wants her pact removed and Belzenlok in pieces.
timeline.quote: I want this pact off my body. I want Belzenlok in pieces.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle rises from the swamp, a living creature that killed all the panther warriors, and flings itself at the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: Then Yargle roared and flung itself at the Weatherlight .

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 11" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Liliana saves Jhoira from falling from the tilting deck.
timeline.quote: Liliana managed to wedge herself between the deck and the rail, gripping Jhoira's arm to keep her from falling.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha pries open Yargle's jaws and frees the Weatherlight, then bears Yargle down into the swamp.
timeline.quote: Muldrotha extruded a limb made of rotting wood and corpses into Yargle's clamped jaw and pried it open.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 12" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 May 2018.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!
